scope: Architecture figures and their configuration-dependent supporting facts; comparison of primary publications and pinned official code, not model execution or performance reproduction.
common_findings: The old audit missed real paper/code disagreements and incompatible variant combinations. Each figure now names one configuration; differences remain explicit rather than being silently reconciled.

LingBot-VA released video/action forward paths share one transformer; the paper describes separate towers. The pinned checkpoint headers confirm the shared-width action projections and approximately 5.1B parameters.

Cosmos-Predict1 uses the released 4B base graph. Cosmos-Predict2.5 uses the 35-step base Video2World sampler. NWM uses the released 250-step DDPM. Flash, distilled and base latency/sampler claims are no longer combined in those figures.

SOLD, SlotFormer, TransDreamer, UniZero and UVA now follow the selected released configuration, with paper differences recorded. Missing final norms, input projections and adaptive residual gates were corrected where code supplies them.
Rollout arrows now name actual tensor endpoints. Sampled codes, predicted features, latents and cached K/V return to the matching stage; robot actions are not drawn as direct image-encoder inputs.
All 49 unused legacy diagram specifications and historical verification counters were removed. Default rendering and the website use the same reviewed flow, with current source coverage in each card.

Undisclosed details stay undisclosed. For seven models no matching official implementation was found in the consulted sources: AAPT, comma.ai, Dreamer 4, GAIA-1, GAIA-2, Genie and the long-context SSM model.

The source ledger binds each review to the complete card and records immutable code revisions plus source-byte hashes. These are reproducibility/integrity checks, not automated proof of scientific correctness.

A follow-up independent check of this review found four wrong edits and several removals of source-backed content; they were fixed: SOLD keeps the paper's and checkpoint's 4 slot-aggregation layers, LingBot-VA and the long-context SSM model keep their closed rollout loops, Genie's block count stays the paper's L, and mixed-configuration labels were made consistent with each figure. The former 'verified' evidence level stays retired, because it described a check of an earlier version of the facts.

aapt.name: AAPT
aapt.architecture: The VAE packs four frames per latent step. Noise, conditioning and the previous frame are concatenated by channel; projected text tokens join the sequence, and the diffusion timestep is a stated input whose injection point is undisclosed. The 36-block generator uses block-causal attention with a bounded latent-history cache and predicts one clean latent frame in one evaluation.

Added the stated diffusion-timestep input (Sec. 2.1) to the figure inputs and the Core fact; it is not drawn as a side box because its injection point is not disclosed.
limitations: No matching official generator implementation was found in the consulted sources. Width, heads, patch geometry, internal norms, FFN and residual placement are not disclosed; none are supplied from a conventional DiT.

comma_wm.variant: Official openpilot 0.11 technical post: 2B, 15 Euler steps
comma_wm.architecture: A ViT compressor produces a continuous latent per two-camera observation. The 48-layer, width-1600, 25-head DiT uses block-causal attention and AdaLN-single conditioned on pose, noise and frame index. Fifteen guided Euler updates generate the next latent before the ViT decoder.

cosmos3.name: Cosmos 3
cosmos3.variant: Nano generation (50 FM steps); reasoner text decoding not drawn
cosmos3.architecture: Text and ViT tokens pass once through the reasoner, whose per-layer keys and values are cached. Clean video, audio and action conditioning is encoded by the Wan2.2 VAE, the audio VAE and per-embodiment action projections. In each of the 50 flow-matching steps the noisy DM tokens (plus timestep embedding) are packed with the clean DM tokens and the cached AR context, and pass through 36 generator-tower layers (RMSNorm, own QKV with 3D MRoPE, DM-to-AR+DM attention, own MLP), a final norm and the per-modality out-projections. Video latents go to the Wan2.2 VAE decoder, audio to the audio VAE decoder, and action tokens give the action chunk.

The released base sampler performs 35 FlowUniPC steps with text guidance before decoding the clip.

cwm.name: CWM (Code World Model)
cwm.architecture: A Llama-tokenized execution trace is processed by 64 pre-RMSNorm decoder blocks with grouped-query attention and SwiGLU. Layers alternate local and global attention windows in a 3:1 pattern; the fanout denotes a layer-type choice, not two attention computations in every layer. Text tokens are generated autoregressively.

delta_iris.architecture: An action-conditioned delta tokenizer encodes frame changes; an auxiliary CNN supplies the current-frame I-token. The three-layer width-512 causal transformer uses learned positions, pre-LayerNorm residual blocks, GELU and a final LayerNorm. Four dependent delta-code predictions reconstruct the next frame.

dino_wm.variant: Released DINO-WM predictor: 6 layers, DINOv2 patch features

Action and proprioception embeddings are concatenated to each patch feature; learned positions precede six pre-LayerNorm attention/MLP blocks and a final norm. Frame-causal masking allows within-frame patch attention. Predicted features enter subsequent latent rollout and CEM planning, without a pixel decoder.

dreamer4.name: Dreamer 4
dreamer4.variant: Paper: 1.6B dynamics, 3 spatial layers per causal temporal layer
dreamer4.architecture: A causal tokenizer provides continuous visual latents. Shortcut dynamics include noisy visual tokens, action/task tokens, learned register tokens and one shortcut token carrying the signal level and step size. The disclosed pre-RMSNorm/RoPE/SwiGLU design repeats three spatial layers and one causal temporal layer. Four shortcut steps generate latents; policy, reward and value heads read task representations.

Both released transformers use post-LayerNorm residual blocks with ReLU FFNs. Reward and continuation depend on latent/state features.

lc_ssm.name: Long-Context SSM World Model
lc_ssm.architecture: Spatial-major latent tokens pass through an AdaLN-conditioned Mamba scan, frame-local attention, and FFN, each with its own gated residual. Recurrent state is maintained per spatial scan block and frame-local attention keeps a KV cache of the previous k = 10 frames. Frames are generated autoregressively one at a time: each denoised latent frame re-enters the token sequence as clean context. The original block figure, rather than a generic transformer template, determines this order.

Six predictor layers, a final LayerNorm and a projector predict the next embedding. Planning uses embeddings without decoding pixels.
